messages:
maria: Quick sync - EdgeEmbed (hardware accelerator) wants marketplace listing next quarter. Need final list of security/compliance artifacts (firmware SBOM, SOC2 summary, pen test report, signed library attestations) and owners for redaction + presign uploads. Also confirm presign TTL.

ajay: I can own presign uploads. Propose 7-day presign TTL for partner S3 artifacts.

lena: SI team wants a 2-week window for remote pen-test witnessing. Mornings PST preferred.

maria: Legal embargo/NDA needs confirming before witnesses are allowed. Sophie?

sophie: Legal will require explicit endpoint list and data class mapping. Also need signed attestations for closed-source binaries and a hash manifest.

security-bot: NOTE: Standard marketplace evidence checklist: SOC2 Type II summary, vuln scan (<30d), pen-test report (redaction markers), SBOM, KMS/HSM attestation if keys present.

tom: Action items: Ajay -> presign flow + 7d TTL; Lena -> schedule SI witness + Doodle; Maria -> request firmware SBOM + signed attestation from vendor; Sophie -> NDA scope checklist.

ajay: Presign example command: `aws s3 presign s3://redwood-partner-ingest/edgeembed/firmware-v1.bin --expires-in 604800`. Will gate by mime-type and require `x-partner-id: edgeembed` metadata header. I'll drop a runbook in the shared drive and grant write to lena/maria.

lena: Raj (SI lead) prefers PST mornings. I'll propose windows 2026-05-10 to 2026-05-24.

maria: For redaction: require vendor to provide pre-redacted artifact for public listing + raw artifact to secure S3 for internal review. Raw access limited to legal/sec/SI.

sophie: Confirmed list: pre-redacted PDFs, raw reports to secure bucket, HSM attest if keys used, SBOM JSON, signed attest doc. Retention: 30 days post-listing per SOW.

security-bot: REMINDER: tag the runner ticket `marketplace-evidence` to track RBAC/retention.

tom: I'll create the tracker and assign deadlines: vendor artifacts due 2026-04-15; pen witness window early May; review complete by 2026-05-31.

maria: Please react with :thumbsup: if you agree. Will lock plan if no objections by EOD.

ajay: :thumbsup:
lena: :thumbsup:
sophie: :thumbsup:
tom: :thumbsup:
security-bot: :eyes:
